notes.title: Never stop smurfing 💭 The Smurfs - Dreams now available
notes.content:
Hello Smurfs in the making,

Gargamel has devised a new evil scheme to catch the Smurfs, and only you can stop him! Dive into the fantastic journey of The Smurfs - Dreams, now available!

[previewyoutube=8Dtl9DiYc4g;full][/previewyoutube]

🤝 Solo or with a friend - Prevent Gargamel's evil plans from succeeding, alone or with a friend for a smurfabulous 2-player experience

💭 Dive headfirst into other Smurfs' dreams - Visit unique and vibrant worlds as you hop from dream to dream, and discover all of the Smurf Village's secrets

🎭 Embark on the Smurfs' imagination - Each dream hides a nightmare - help the Smurfs overcoming their fears through puzzles, boss fights and many other surprises

🏃 Jump, hop and dash - Use your movements and tools to overcome the many challenges dreamt by the Smurfs

🔮 A Smurf like you - Collect magic orbs and patterns to customize your Smurf

notes.title: 🎮 Get ready to smurf with the Demo version of The Smurfs - Dreams 💭
notes.content:
Hello Smurfs in the making,

Discover Chef Smurf’s and Vanity Smurf’s dreams (or nightmares…?) in the Demo version of The Smurfs - Dreams, available on October 24th!

[previewyoutube=oKPE9BsBs7o;full][/previewyoutube]

Gargamel has devised a new evil scheme to catch the Smurfs! He casted a cunning curse on the sarsaparilla bushes, causing a deep slumber across the Smurfs after they eat the delicious leaves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925924/ce63641eb3b68117f7290a5e80f408460ee754ef.jpg

Alone or with a friend, discover enchanting locations and explore the dreams of your favorite Smurfs. Each dream is a unique adventure, with smurfingly exciting challenges and mind-boggling puzzles. Imagination comes to life in this fully immersive and magical 3D platformer.
